meta.label: Jev Question Set
meta.description: Asks typed yes/no, choice and score questions about one input in a single Jev call, and saves each answer to the agent state.

params.name: llm
params.label: TypeSafe Jev model
params.description: A Chat completion model of type TypeSafe Jev, such as custom:typesafe:jev.

params.name: input_key
params.label: Input key
params.description: Top-level key of the state or scratchpad value to judge.

params.name: questions
params.label: Questions
params.description: Independent questions about the same input, sent together in one Jev call. They cannot see each other's answers.

subParams.name: id
subParams.label: Name
subParams.description: Letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, e.g. team. Becomes the output column or state key.

selectChoices.label: Choice: one option out of a set

subParams.name: instructions
subParams.label: Question
subParams.description: Ask one narrow judgment. Refer to JSON fields of the input with backticks, e.g. `ticket_text`.

subParams.name: yes_criteria
subParams.label: What counts as yes
subParams.description: Optional. Describe both yes and no, or neither.

subParams.name: options
subParams.label: Options
subParams.description: At least 2. Add a catch-all option when nothing may fit.

subParams.name: levels
subParams.label: Levels, lowest first
subParams.description: 2 to 10 concrete situations. The first level is 0; the score can fall between levels.

params.name: questions_json
params.label: Questions JSON
params.description: A JSON object of named TypeSafe questions, see https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives

params.name: output_key
params.label: Save details as
params.description: Each answer is saved under its question name. Full answers, model, usage and latency go under this key, and a readable summary under <key>_summary.
